ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: I selected Willet-235B because the task—citing textual evidence to support a claim about a character's emotional state—is a close-reading and extraction task. Willet-235B scores meaningfully higher on the relevant internal evals (Extraction & Retrieval 85.3 vs. Curlew's 81.6, beyond the 2.0-point variance threshold) and on broad reasoning/instruction-following benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, Arena-Hard). The user also wants it done thoroughly ("don't half-do it"), which favors the stronger instruction-following model. The content is benign, so neither model's harm-adjacent preferences are relevant.
